%% QUAN HE HOA DON VA KHACH HANG / NHAN VIEN
HoaDon "0..*" --> "1" KhachHang : cua khach
HoaDon "0..*" --> "1" NhanVien : do nhan vien lap

%% COMPOSITION - HOA DON CHUA CHI TIET
HoaDon "1" *-- "0..*" ChiTietHoaDon : gom chi tiet
ChiTietHoaDon "0..*" --> "1" SanPham : san pham duoc ban

%% TRANG THAI HOA DON
HoaDon --> TrangThaiHoaDon : trang thai

%% QUAN HE PHIEU NHAP
PhieuNhap "0..*" --> "1" NhaCungCap : nhap tu
PhieuNhap "0..*" --> "1" NhanVien : do nhan vien lap

%% COMPOSITION - PHIEU NHAP CHUA CHI TIET
PhieuNhap "1" *-- "0..*" ChiTietPhieuNhap : gom chi tiet
ChiTietPhieuNhap "0..*" --> "1" SanPham : san pham duoc nhap

%% TRANG THAI PHIEU NHAP
PhieuNhap --> TrangThaiPhieuNhap : trang thai

%% AGGREGATION - QUAN LY DANH SACH
DanhSachSanPham "1" o-- "0..*" SanPham : quan ly
DanhSachHoaDon "1" o-- "0..*" HoaDon : quan ly
DanhSachPhieuNhap "1" o-- "0..*" PhieuNhap : quan ly

%% KHO - CAP NHAT TON KHO KHI GIAO DICH
DichVuKho --> DanhSachSanPham : cap nhat ton
DichVuKho ..> HoaDon : xac nhan ban hang
DichVuKho ..> PhieuNhap : xac nhan nhap hang

%% BAO CAO - SU DUNG CAC DANH SACH
BaoCaoThongKe --> DanhSachSanPham : thong ke ton
BaoCaoThongKe --> DanhSachHoaDon : doanh thu
BaoCaoThongKe --> DanhSachPhieuNhap : gia tri nhap
